# `0.1.1-alpha.0` revised phase 9 — automated intake qualification evidence

Compact, committed evidence of the revised phase 9 synthetic intake
qualification (`ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.md` §5). The generated images, scanner
folders, project databases and evidence logs are **not** committed; they stay
in the local campaign folders named below. How the campaign works:
[`docs/intake_qualification.md`](../../../intake_qualification.md). Handoff:
[`PHASE_I_HANDOFF.md`](../../../../development/releases/0.1.1-alpha.0/PHASE_I_HANDOFF.md).

## What it proves — and what it does not

It proves automated **source-build** behaviour under a large synthetic
multi-source intake campaign with controlled failures and exact ground truth.

It does **not** prove: genuine SMB / network-share behaviour (the outage is a
local folder junction removed and restored); real scanner behaviour; actual
power-loss durability (process-kill crash safety: tested; power-loss
durability: not tested); real-paper calibration of the quality policy (the
unvalidated default); installed-build behaviour; production readiness.
